name: Gerard de Lairesse
description: painter and engraver from the Northern Netherlands (1641-1711)

summary.text: Gerard or Gérard (de) Lairesse was a Dutch Golden Age painter and art theorist. His broad range of skills included music, poetry, and theatre.
summary.title: Gerard de Lairesse
